GameConfig.description: Compile-time constants that govern window geometry, timing, and player placement.

logicalWidth.description: Logical pixel width of the game window before scaling.

logicalHeight.description: Logical pixel height of the game window before scaling.

scale.description: Integer scale factor applied to logical dimensions for physical window size.

targetFps.description: Target frames per second enforced by pygame.time.Clock().tick().

wallThickness.description: Pixel thickness of each perimeter wall rectangle.

playerSize.description: Side length of the player square in logical pixels.

playerStartX.description: Deterministic X coordinate of the player square's top-left corner at startup.

playerStartY.description: Deterministic Y coordinate of the player square's top-left corner at startup.

RoomColors.description: Color palette for the room. All values are CSS hex color strings (#RRGGBB).

background.description: Solid fill color of the inner room area.

wall.description: Fill color of the four perimeter wall rectangles.

player.description: Fill color of the player square.

ExitSignal.description: Represents the signal that caused the main loop to exit.

kind.description: ESC = KEYDOWN pygame.K_ESCAPE; OS_CLOSE = pygame.QUIT event.
